CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   B. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.

4. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   B. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   D. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

10. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.
   B. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   B. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Gambling 6 6.5 Social Media 7 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The suggested nu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Gambling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Social Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
